title: Neo4j Cypher Statement
description: A Cypher query statement with parameters for execution against a Neo4j database through the HTTP or Query API.

statement.description: The Cypher query string to execute against the Neo4j database

parameters.description: Named parameters for the Cypher query. Always use parameters instead of string concatenation to protect against Cypher injection when incorporating user input.

resultDataContents.description: Requested result formats for the HTTP API. Possible values include row for tabular data and graph for graph visualization data.

includeStats.description: Whether to include query execution statistics such as nodes created, relationships created, and properties set in the response.
